      live "/schedule/jobs/:id/assign", ScheduleLive.JobLive, :assign
      live "/schedule/jobs/:id", ScheduleLive.JobLive, :show
      live "/schedule/cleaners/new", ScheduleLive.CleanerLive, :new
      live "/schedule/cleaners/:id", ScheduleLive.CleanerLive, :show
      live "/schedule/cleaners/:cleaner_id/time-off/new", ScheduleLive.AvailabilityLive, :new

      live "/audit", AuditLive, :index

      live "/quotes", QuoteLive.Index, :index
      live "/quotes/new", QuoteLive.Builder, :new
      live "/quotes/:id", QuoteLive.Builder, :show

      live "/quality", QualityLive.Review, :index
      live "/quality/scorecards", QualityLive.Scorecards, :index
      live "/quality/templates", QualityLive.Templates, :index
      live "/quality/templates/new", QualityLive.Templates, :new
      live "/quality/templates/:id/edit", QualityLive.Templates, :edit
      live "/quality/:job_id", QualityLive.Review, :show

      live "/timesheets", TimesheetLive, :index

      live "/invoices", InvoiceLive.Index, :index
      live "/invoices/:id", InvoiceLive.Show, :show

      live "/reminders", ReminderLive, :index
    end

    post "/users/update-password", UserSessionController, :update_password
  end

  scope "/", CleanerCrmWeb do
    pipe_through [:browser, :require_authenticated_user, :require_office_role]

    get "/timesheets/export", TimesheetExportController, :show
  end

  scope "/integrations/oauth", CleanerCrmWeb do
    pipe_through [:browser, :require_authenticated_user]

    get "/:provider", IntegrationsController, :request
    get "/callback/:provider", IntegrationsController, :callback
  end

  scope "/", CleanerCrmWeb do
    pipe_through [:browser]

    live_session :current_user,
      on_mount: [{CleanerCrmWeb.UserAuth, :mount_current_scope}] do
      live "/users/register", UserLive.Registration, :new
      live "/users/log-in", UserLive.Login, :new
      live "/users/log-in/:token", UserLive.Confirmation, :new
      live "/invitations/accept/:token", InvitationsLive.Accept, :new
    end

    post "/users/log-in", UserSessionController, :create
    delete "/users/log-out", UserSessionController, :delete

    # Public confirm/reschedule links a client reaches from their
    # reminder — no login, so `:browser` (not `:require_authenticated_user`)
    # like the routes above. Plain `:browser`, not `:public`, so
    # `fetch_current_scope_for_user` still assigns `current_scope` for
    # the root layout.
    get "/reminders/confirm/:token", ReminderController, :confirm
    get "/reminders/reschedule/:token", ReminderController, :reschedule
  end

  scope "/", CleanerCrmWeb do
    pipe_through :public

    get "/pay/:token", PaymentController, :show
    post "/pay/:token", PaymentController, :create
  end

  scope "/webhooks", CleanerCrmWeb do
    pipe_through :webhook

    post "/stripe", StripeWebhookController, :create
    post "/twilio", TwilioWebhookController, :status
  end
end

input.summary: Office role gate implemented, all tests green
input.message:
Done, resolving f7ee0171-73e9-4df7-a71d-ae9e0f926a5f.

New: lib/cleaner_crm_web/require_office_role.ex — CleanerCrmWeb.RequireOfficeRole, dual-purpose (mirrors UserAuth's style): on_mount :default for live_sessions, plus a Plug (init/call) for controllers. Checks Accounts.get_user_role(scope, user.id, active_account_id) in [:owner,:admin]; redirects to /field with flash "You don't have access to that page." when not.

Modified: lib/cleaner_crm_web/router.ex — split the one authenticated live_session into :require_authenticated_user (settings, accounts, integrations, /field*) and a new :require_office_role live_session (clients, schedule incl. plan/job/cleaner/availability, audit, quotes, quality, timesheets, invoices, reminders) with on_mount [UserAuth :require_authenticated, RequireOfficeRole :default]. AuditLive keeps its own owner-only mount check on top. Added pipeline :require_office_role (plug CleanerCrmWeb.RequireOfficeRole) and gated GET /timesheets/export the same way.

Test fix: test/spex/834.../criterion_7177_reassignment_reaches_the_cleaners_schedule_spex.exs had Ben (a cleaner/:member) logging in and hitting /schedule directly to prove durability — contradicts the new model. Changed it to reload /schedule from a second fresh owner session instead; assertions/selectors unchanged. This was the only office-surface spec using a cleaner conn — audited all 55 files touching cleaner_fixture/qa-cleaner.

FYI (not fixed, out of scope): priv/repo/qa_seeds.exs creates qa-cleaner but never calls add_user_to_account for it, so it isn't actually a member of the seeded account (active_account_id would be nil, not :member) — my gate still works correctly either way, but worth knowing before manual QA.

Results: MIX_ENV=test mix compile --force clean, 0 warnings. mix spex: 100/100. mix test: 160/160. mix format: my files clean (one pre-existing unformatted spex file, criterion_7176, untouched by me and unrelated).

NEEDS RELEASE REBUILD.

content.text:
I've sent the report to the team lead. Summary of the fix:

**New file:** `/Users/johndavenport/Documents/github/cleaner_crm/lib/cleaner_crm_web/require_office_role.ex` — a `CleanerCrmWeb.RequireOfficeRole` module providing both a LiveView `on_mount` hook and a Plug, checking `Accounts.get_user_role(scope, user.id, active_account_id) in [:owner, :admin]` and redirecting anyone else to `/field` with an error flash.

**Modified:** `/Users/johndavenport/Documents/github/cleaner_crm/lib/cleaner_crm_web/router.ex` — split the single authenticated `live_session` into a shared one (`/users/settings`, `/accounts*`, `/integrations`, `/field*`) and a new office-only `live_session :require_office_role` covering `ClientLive.*`, `ScheduleLive.*`, `AuditLive`, `QuoteLive.*`, `QualityLive.*`, `TimesheetLive`, `InvoiceLive.*`, and `ReminderLive`. Also added a `:require_office_role` plug pipeline and applied it to `GET /timesheets/export`.

**Test fix:** one spex (`criterion_7177_reassignment_reaches_the_cleaners_schedule_spex.exs`) had a cleaner logging in and hitting `/schedule` directly, which contradicts the new security model — I changed it to verify durability via a second owner session instead, an audit of all 55 files touching cleaner fixtures found this was the only such case.

**Verification:** clean `MIX_ENV=test mix compile --force` (no warnings), `mix spex` 100/100, `mix test` 160/160, and `mix format` clean on all files I touched. Also flagged to the team lead that `qa_seeds.exs` never actually adds `qa-cleaner` to the seeded account as a member (pre-existing gap, out of scope, doesn't affect correctness of the new gate). A release rebuild is needed since the QA server runs a detached release.
